narrative: Inventory optimization completed for material PL2__M13FA8BE. The optimized policy reduces total annual cost by 41.2% ($943.65) compared to SAP current policy. Safety stock reduced from 17491 to 1062 units, while order quantity increased from 17491 to 26232 units. The demand analysis reveals a two-phase pattern with significant uplift (2.4x), suggesting recent demand growth. Lead time is highly variable (CV=1.37), dominated by lead time variability (63.8%). The capacity constraint is satisfied with total inventory of 27294 units below the maximum of 66698 units.
